title: Exception Joining DataFrames and Series
body:
In [23]: a=DataFrame(randn(5,2),index=[1,2,3,6,7],columns=['a','b'])

In [24]: b=Series([6,7,8,9],index=[0,1,2,3],name='c')

In [25]: c=Series([6,7,8,9],name='c')

In [26]: a
Out[26]: 
   a       b  
1 -0.268  -0.1305
2  0.2243  0.4644
3  0.4767 -0.5677
6  0.1806  0.6276
7  0.9767  0.3687

In [27]: b
Out[27]: 
0    6
1    7
2    8
3    9
Name: c

Out[28]: 
0    6
1    7
2    8
3    9
Name: c
